article.headline: Duquesne earns 65-47 win over Towson
article.description: — Cam Crawford's 13 points helped Duquesne defeat Towson 65-47 on Saturday night.
article.story: AKRON, Ohio -- — Cam Crawford's 13 points helped Duquesne defeat Towson 65-47 on Saturday night. Crawford shot 5 for 8, including 3 for 5 from beyond the arc for the Dukes (3-8). Tre Dinkins shot 4 for 9, including 4 for 7 from beyond the arc to add 12 points. Jakub Necas had 10 points and went 4 of 6 from the field (1 for 3 from 3-point range). The Tigers (4-7) were led by Nendah Tarke, who recorded 10 points and two steals. Tyler Tejada added eight points and two blocks for Towson. Tomiwa Sulaiman also had eight points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
